attribute_descriptions.case_number: Number of distinct precedent cases referenced in the judgment, including those cited, considered, discussed, or applied (e.g., 'Australian Competition and Consumer Commission v Rana' counts as 1; enter an integer, e.g., 1)
attribute_descriptions.case_type: type of the case, choose one from [Criminal Case, Civil Case, Commercial Case, Administrative Case]; (e.g., Criminal Case)
attribute_descriptions.defendant_current_status: current occupation or type of the defendant (rules same as for plaintiff; e.g., government)
attribute_descriptions.first_judge: whether it was the first judgment (1 if yes, 0 if none; e.g., 1)
attribute_descriptions.hearing_year: year when the hearing began; use format YYYY (e.g., 2009)
attribute_descriptions.legal_basis_num: Number of distinct legal statutes or codes cited in the judgment (e.g., 'Trade Practices Act 1974' counts as 1; enter an integer, e.g., 1)
attribute_descriptions.plaintiff_current_status: current occupation or type of the plaintiff (if an individual, write occupation; if multiple people, use the first individual's occupation; if an organization, write 'organization'; if a company, write 'company'; if a government body, write 'government'; leave empty if unknown; e.g., company)
attribute_descriptions.verdict: court's decision, choose one from: [Guilty, Not Guilty, Others, Dismissed, Approved]; (e.g., Guilty)

estimator.count_distinct: unused; Chao unseen-mass plus HT identity indicators if a future query needs it; identity is __entity_id when the grain is the entity
estimator.max_min: certainty tail from WCCI extremes and top numeric candidates; validated value, else WCCI; never a scaled sample

fallback: retain the frozen WCCI bag for any query that fails acceptance
name: control-variate survey query execution

prompts.extraction_system: You extract one document's contribution to a SQL group-by query. Return JSON only. Do not compute a corpus total, do not list other cases, and do not invent values that the document does not support.
prompts.validation_system: You check one proposed row contribution against cited evidence. Return JSON only. Decide accept, reject, or uncertain. Do not propose a replacement value.

sampling.combination: weight each wave's Horvitz-Thompson residual by its expected sample size
sampling.nonresponse: an unknown contribution is omitted; it is not coded as FALSE or zero

stopping: stop a query when its acceptance gate already passes, when expected variance reduction is below 2 percent, or when the next complete call cannot be reserved
